title: Role
description: A generic job, shipped with the framework (framework/roles/ only): prompt, definition of done, rules, skills, a default tier and its access. It names neither an agent (the LLM product), nor an env, nor data: each mode says which env a role works in (`roles:`), its role units read the read-only endpoints of the mode's `needs`, and the mode's playbooks, skills and rules say what to do.

description.description: When a coordinator should use this role. Written for the coordinator.

uses.description: Deprecated (0.3) and ignored: a role reads the read-only endpoints of the needs of the mode it works in.

access.description: read: tools of read-only capabilities (and web research) only; write: also tools of capabilities with write effects (edit files, shell). Connector endpoints are always read-only for roles.

tier.description: Default tier of this role's steps; a feature or step may set another. The agent profile maps it to a model.

effort.description: Default effort (default medium); a feature or step may set another.
